circuits.display_name: Real 5T CMFB (PMOS-input error amp + resistive CM detector, canonical)

provenance.notes: The first REAL (transistor-level) member of the cmfb class — the drop-in replacement for the ideal CMFB macromodels (identical pin footprint; swapping a consumer is a pure symbol-path change). CANONICAL polarity: PMOS pair puts the sensed CM on the + input, vcmfb = A*(cm_sense - vref) — for INVERTING plants (B5 rule; the -inv wiring variant for non-inverting plants exists in drawings/ shared as cmfb-output-amp-5t-pmos-input-inv, not separately accessioned: same topology, swapped pair gates). Self-biased via an on-cell 2-diode string — the block has NO bias pin, so composition needs no bias plumbing. Chosen (over the NMOS-input flavor, cmfb_003) for the SRMC core consumer: its zero-error natural output sits nearest the plant's actuator balance gates and its PMOS pair is comfortable at the 0.5 V sensed CM. Rail-clamped by construction — in-loop CM kicks recover with zero residual (vs the unclamped macromodel's basin escapes). In-loop validation (sized amp_031 SRMC core, both loops real): CM errors 3.6/2.1 mV, diff 54.72 dB / 76.9 MHz / PM 58.9 deg, 116.4 uA total; consumer drawing SRMC-core-amp-w-cmfb-5t.sch (SIZING_VALIDATION_REPORT.md §8).

circuits.display_name: Fan CCIA + composed ripple-reduction loop (COMPOSITE: ia_002 + sup_003)

provenance.designer: Composition by Noorizadeh; blocks: ia_002 + sup_003 (hand-drawn Fan corpus)
provenance.notes: The full Fan architecture the drawn tops omit: the ripple-reduction loop (sup_003) composed around the chopper CCIA (ia_002) — RRL senses the output ripple, demodulates at the output-chopper clock, integrates through a two-phase SC network, and injects the DC correction at the first-stage outputs (pre output chopper). This entry is a STRUCTURALLY-COMPLETE composer demonstration (the P4 composer builds the flat hierarchical composite) but is STATICALLY CHARACTERIZED ONLY. HONEST LIMITATION (2026-07-17 adversarial verify): the composed core has NO common-mode control, so once the RRL's SC clocks actually run, the output CM rails to ~+1.19 V within ~1-2 ms and every clocked transient aborts — so the ripple-nulling figure and the demodulation-sign question (DRAWING_REVIEW §4.2) CANNOT be exercised on this composite. (An earlier v_ripple0_pp "~40x nulling" headline here was measured with the SC clocks accidentally undriven, i.e. the RRL INERT — that bench bug is fixed in the template and the invalid headline removed.) The clocked RRL benches are therefore not bound; the RRL demonstration + demod sign are deferred to the core-CM closure composite (plan P4-4b, cf. amp_030). The static benches (cap-ratio gain, HPF corner, static Zin) are valid and bound.

provenance.notes: TRUE 4-gate differential chopper modulator: 2 straight transmission gates (va_p->vb_p / va_n->vb_n, conduct when vctl HIGH) + 2 cross gates (va_p->vb_n / va_n->vb_p on swapped controls, conduct when vctl LOW) — polarity reversal proven electrically in the drawing review (drawings/DRAWING_REVIEW.md item 1, FIXED 2026-07-16); this entry matches the fixed drawing. Hand-flattened here from the drawing's four transmission_gate_pair instances x1..x4; the rails vdd/vss exist ONLY as bulk connections.
provenance.paper: Q. Fan, F. Sebastiano, J. H. Huijsing, K. A. A. Makinwa, "A 1.8 uW 60 nV/sqrt(Hz) Capacitively-Coupled Chopper Instrumentation Amplifier in 65 nm CMOS for Wireless Sensor Nodes", IEEE JSSC 46(7):1534-1543, Jul. 2011

provenance.designer: Noorizadeh (schematic capture, after Hsu et al.)
provenance.notes: 3-bit BINARY-weighted programmable capacitor bank: one fixed unit cap C1 (vinp<->vout) plus three TG-switched caps C2/C3/C4 whose bottom plates the six transmission_gate_pair instances route to vinp (bit HIGH) or park at VCM (bit LOW) — C_eff = (1+code)*Cu. The Cin-setting gain element of the Hsu PGA (ia_005_hsu_pga_ideal instantiates it twice). BINARY parameterization is the owner decision of 2026-07-19 (DRAWING_REVIEW.md §8 finding 1, RESOLVED): every cap carries the shared unit value Cu and the weighting is STRUCTURAL via the cap multiplier m (C1 fixed m=1, C2(D0) m=1, C3(D1) m=2, C4(D2) m=4); live-validated C_eff exactly 1p..8p @ Cu=1p, all 8 codes distinct/monotonic. Hand-flattened here from the drawing's six transmission_gate_pair instances x1..x6; the rails VDD/VSS exist ONLY as bulk connections.
provenance.paper: Y.-P. Hsu, Z. Liu, M. M. Hella, "A -68 dB THD, 0.6 mm2 Active Area Biosignal Acquisition System With a 40-320 Hz Duty-Cycle Controlled Filter", IEEE TCAS-I 67(1):233-245, Jan. 2020
provenance.source: drawings/shared (hand-drawn xschem, capbank.sch; bio-afe-01 landing manifest drawings/bio-afe-01-YuPinHsu-reconfigable-SRMC/landing.yaml)
